name: Copy Catchers
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you surveil, you may pay {1}{U}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of this creature.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you surveil, you may pay {1}{U}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of this creature.

needs.what: a trigger event fired once each time a player surveils (701.25c: once per surveil instruction, even surveil 0 is not a surveil, and it fires after the cards are placed), with a controller/player filter so "whenever you surveil" matches only the ability controller's own surveils
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no surveil event; the nearest are draw, put_into_graveyard (fires per card milled into the graveyard and not at all when every card stays on top) and connives/investigates/searches_library, which are other keyword actions. The rest of the line is expressible: a may with pay {mana: "{1}{U}"} around copy_permanent with objects {self_only: true}
